newsitem.title: USA: M.D.C. Holdings Q1 home orders fall 11 pct.
newsitem.headline: M.D.C. Holdings Q1 home orders fall 11 pct.

text.p: M.D.C. Holdings Inc said Wednesday its orders for homes fell 11 percent in the first quarter, to 1,520 from 1,721 in the year-ago period.
The company said the decrease stemmed in part from increased orders in the 1996 period in both Colorado and the Mid-Atlantic region due to favorable mortgage rates available at that time.
The company added, however, that its home gross margins in the first quarter will be higher than the 14.1 percent of the 1996 fourth quarter.
